summary.text: Kori Rodley is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for the Oregon House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Adam Wilson (R/Libertarian). She works in government administration and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Rodley graduated from Roseburg High School and lists government administration as her profession.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked on improving policing, fire safety and emergency services for the city of Springfield over the past few years.

Rodley's stated campaign priorities in that survey were eliminating barriers to building housing at all levels, getting families affordable childcare, strong neighborhood schools, food, healthcare and other services, and public safety.

She also named affordable and accessible childcare, affordable housing, public education, affordable healthcare and inclusive economic development with living-wage jobs as policy areas she is passionate about.
